correctness.rationale: The inclusive Rips complex on the 64 Hamming vertices is the independence complex of the 7-regular forbidden graph with edges at distances 5 and 6. Every nonidentity translation acts freely in 32 two-element vertex orbits; stable simplices are unions of eligible orbits, with the chain-orientation sign contributing the negative of the quotient signed independence sum. Independent exact memoized branching of the 64-vertex independence polynomial gave Z=253 (3,974,224 states); independent quotient bit-mask recursions gave signed sums 9,9,53,53,1,1 for weights 1..6. The Fourier inversion over all 64 translations returns multiplicities (36,1,0,6,6,0,1), with dimensions summing 253 and 36 invariants. Passage from virtual reduced Lefschetz to genuine trace explicitly depends on the published 2026 rational homology concentration: reduced H7 rank 239 and H15 rank 14, both odd degrees; those very large homology matrices were NOT recomputed. No assertion about separate-degree characters or torsion.
residual_risks: Finite experimental corroboration does not substitute for infinite claim, unless exhaustive finite reduction independently justified.
